notes: The dataset card's own YAML front matter declares license: cc-by-sa-4.0 (line 8 of the selected README.md). This repository's prefetch document independently records the ARC dataset as CC-BY-SA-4.0. The full license text is not present locally, only these two declarations of it.
Only the train splits of ARC-Challenge and ARC-Easy are selected. The test and validation splits are deliberately left out of candidate view.

CONTENT CAVEAT: the ARC parquet schema includes an answerKey column, i.e. the upstream multiple-choice key. That key is public corpus material and is not this program's evaluator answer; Odyssey H answers (hidden_generator_class) are generated by src/substrate/odyssey_task_bank.py::_science and held in the evaluator-only manifest. The H tasks use evidence.arc_slot as an index into the corpus rather than posing ARC questions, so the key discloses nothing about H scoring. A custodian may still choose an answerKey-free projection if the strict reading of the G03 precondition is preferred.
Not legal advice; recorded rights review only.
